## `GET /schedules`

Schedules, newest first.

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                                 |
| ------ | ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | array of [ScheduleResource](/reference/api/models/#scheduleresource) |

## `POST /schedules`

Keep a RunSpec to launch every every\_hours; its first run is due at start\_at.

**Request body:** [ScheduleCreate](/reference/api/models/#schedulecreate) (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `201`  | Successful Response | [ScheduleResource](/reference/api/models/#scheduleresource)       |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `DELETE /schedules/{schedule_id}`

Delete the schedule; its runs are kept.

| Parameter     | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| ------------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `schedule_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `204`  | Successful Response | None                                                              |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `POST /schedules/{schedule_id}/trigger`

Launch the schedule's RunSpec now; 409 while its last run is unfinished.

| Parameter     | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| ------------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `schedule_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |

| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |
